results.title: Pind Hospitality IPO Shares Trade 20% Below Issue Price at ₹79.20 on BSE SME
results.description: Pind Hospitality shares made their stock market debut on October 6, 2026, on BSE SME. At the available listing-day snapshot, the stock was trading at ₹79.20 per share compared with the IPO issue price of ₹99 per share, representing a decline of 20%. At the available market snapshot, the stock was trading at ₹79.20. It had touched an intraday high and low of ₹79.20, with 1,200 shares changing hands. The listing followed the company's IPO, which was open for subscription from September 28 to September 30, 2026. The ₹17.82 crore book-built issue was priced in a band of ₹93 to ₹99 per share and received an overall subscription of 2.63 times. Pind Hospitality operates in the hospitality and food-service segment and is associated with the Pind Punjab restaurant brand, with operations centred in Pune. The company is also expanding into hospitality through its planned Haveli project in Lonavala. Pind Hospitality IPO Listing Details Pind Hospitality IPO was a ₹17.82 crore book-built issue comprising 18 lakh equity shares. The issue carried a price band of ₹93 to ₹99 per share. The IPO opened on September 28 and closed on September 30. It was subscribed 2.63 times overall, with Individual Investors subscribing 4.31 times, NIIs 1.14 times and QIBs 1.00 time. - Issue Price: ₹99 per share - BSE SME Trading Price: ₹79.20 per share - Change From Issue Price: -20% - Intraday High: ₹79.20 - Intraday Low: ₹79.20 - Volume: 1,200 shares - Overall Subscription: 2.63 times - Issue Size: ₹17.82 crore - Price Band: ₹93 to ₹99 per share - IPO Open Date: September 28, 2026 - IPO Close Date: September 30, 2026 - Listing Date: October 6, 2026 - Exchange: BSE SME First-Day Trading Performance Listing Price: Pind Hospitality share price was trading at ₹79.20 compared with its ₹99 issue price, representing a 20% decline from the issue price at the available snapshot. Intraday High: The stock's intraday high stood at ₹79.20, 20% below the IPO issue price. Intraday Low: The intraday low was also ₹79.20, 20% below the issue price. Volume: Around 1,200 shares had changed hands at the available snapshot. Subscription Context: The IPO was subscribed 2.63 times overall. Individual Investors led demand at 4.31 times, while NIIs subscribed 1.14 times and QIBs 1.00 time. Growth Drivers and Challenges Growth Drivers Established Restaurant Brand: The company operates under the Pind Punjab brand and has an established customer base in Pune. Multiple Service Channels: Operations combine dine-in services with online food delivery. Hospitality Expansion: The planned Haveli project in Lonavala is intended to expand the company's presence into hospitality and destination events. Operating Track Record: The company has reported profitability and positive operating cash flows. Challenges Geographical Concentration: A significant part of the company's operating revenue is concentrated in Pune. Delivery Platform Dependence: Online food delivery platforms account for an important portion of revenue. Expansion Execution: The planned Lonavala Haveli project introduces execution and capital deployment risks. Lease Exposure: Restaurant operations may be affected by lease renewals and rental increases. Regulatory and Compliance Risks: Hospitality operations remain subject to applicable regulatory and compliance requirements. Utilisation of IPO Proceeds The company intends to deploy the issue proceeds primarily towards its planned Haveli project in Lonavala and general corporate purposes. Principal uses include: - ₹12.70 crore towards capital expenditure for setting up the Haveli project in Lonavala - ₹5.12 crore towards general corporate purposes Business and IPO Overview Pind Hospitality operates in the food-service and hospitality segment, with the Pind Punjab restaurant brand forming an important part of its business. Its operations include dine-in restaurants and online food delivery, while the company is planning to expand into destination hospitality through the Lonavala Haveli project. The IPO was priced at ₹93 to ₹99 per share and received an overall subscription of 2.63 times. Individual Investors subscribed their portion 4.31 times, while NIIs and QIBs subscribed 1.14 times and 1.00 time, respectively. On October 6, Pind Hospitality was trading at ₹79.20 on BSE SME at the available snapshot, 20% below the ₹99 issue price. The intraday high and low were both ₹79.20, with 1,200 shares traded.
